defaultPrompt: Create a clean, publication-ready diagram for this concept.
Choose the best diagram type for my software architecture and explain your layout choices.
Review this diagram for clarity, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and unnecessary complexity.
interface.longDescription: Guidance for designing readable, editorial-style diagrams for software architecture, sequences, data models, processes, planning, and analytics. Includes type selection, layout heuristics, accessibility checks, brand-token guidance, and workflows for rebuilding imported diagrams. This private plugin packages the skill instructions; repository scripts and third-party CLI commands are not bundled as executable ChatGPT tools.

name: diagram-design
description: Create clear, branded, editorial diagrams for software architecture, processes, data, and product workflows.
